title.narrative: Reconstruction and expansion of sewerage systems of in the three cities of Gulistan, Shirin, and Yangier of Syrdarya region

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to improve the coverage and quality of sewerage systems in the three cities of Gulistan, Shirin and Yangiyer in the Syrdarya Region in order to minimize the health and environmental hazards in the targeted area, for an approximate population of 140,000.
